validity.recommendation: Do not treat 'UGDC-Suez Gas Pipeline' as an established, correctly-identified route. Re-derive the true name/endpoints from a legible copy of the GASCO 2018 national-grid map (or a primary EGAS/GASCO document) before relying on this row, or downgrade to a generic Delta-corridor placeholder pending better sourcing.
validity.researcher_notes: No independent source names a pipeline called 'UGDC-Suez Gas Pipeline,' and this row's own three citations all fail on inspection. (1) The Length/Diameter/Status/Fuel/PipelineType ref (EGAS Annual Report 2018, egyptoil-gas.com) is a full-report PDF with no text list that names this pipeline: I applied both tests the scope guidance calls for. TEXT test: pdftotext of the full report contains zero instances of 'UGDC'; '215' appears exactly once, in an unrelated sentence about industrial gas consumption ('215 BSCF (590 MMSCFD)'), and '24' appears only in unrelated entries (West Assiout power-station pipeline 1.4km-24", a 'Project Rehabilitation... 24"' line, etc.) - so the worklist's automated 'expected content present' pass for Length/Diameter is a false positive from coincidental digit matches, not real support. MAP test (per the guidance that many of these rows were read visually off the p.35 GASCO national-grid map): I extracted PDF page 19 (printed page 35, the actual fold-out national-grid map with the GASCO legend) and traced it at high resolution. There IS a real line labeled '24" 215 km' on that map - but it runs from a Delta-interior hub (near the National Gas/Qusina/Banha cluster) into the El-Tina/Sathia junction near Port Said/North Sinai. It does NOT touch a place called 'Suez' at either end, and 'UGDC' does not appear as a label on either end of that line - the only 'UGD' label on the map sits far to the northeast near Damietta, styled with the map's own 'GAS FIELDS' icon (a red flame circle, matching Taust/Akhen/Repco Gas/Wastany/Nedoco nearby), not the 'FACILITIES' icon, i.e. it reads as a gas-field name, not a company plant marker. (2) The Location ref (eib.org/files/pipeline/20070088_eia1_en.pdf) is NOT about this pipeline at all - I downloaded and read it: it is the table of contents of GASCO's 2007 Environmental Impact Assessment for the 'Abr Sinai Onshore Gas Pipeline' (the Trans-Sinai/Abr Sina(i) line covered elsewhere in this batch as P8041/P8044/P8013), with no mention of 'UGDC,' 'Port Said,' or 'Suez' (confirmed both by url_verifier and by reading the extracted text). This looks like a citation mix-up with the Abr Sinai rows, not a source for P8042's endpoints. (3) The ProjectLevelCost ref (petroleum.gov.eg 2019-12-30 ministry year-end release) does not mention UGDC or 55,000,000 EGP anywhere - I read the full article; it lists real 2019 pipeline costs (e.g. the Wasiti/Beni Suef line at 65km/36in/511 million EGP) but none matching this row. Independently, UGDC (United Gas Derivatives Company) is a real company, but its own facility is at Damietta Port, not Suez - confirmed via egyptoil-gas.com coverage of a 2023 UGDC-TCI Sanmar MoU ('UGDC will use its... facilities in Damietta Port') and a 2018 UGDC leadership-appointment article; neither mentions a pipeline to Suez, and no further UGDC-pipeline coverage exists on that outlet. Net: a real 215km/24in Delta-to-El Tina segment likely exists on the ground (it's drawn on GASCO's own map), but the name 'UGDC' and the endpoint 'Suez' recorded for P8042 are not supported by any source I could find, including the row's own cited references - this is either a mislabeled/mis-endpointed real segment or a fabricated combination of a real gas-field name (UGD, near Damietta) and a real corridor it isn't actually part of. Tested against the 40-row roster for a duplicate/relabel match: no other row combines 215km with 24in, so if this is a real segment it isn't yet double-counted elsewhere in this batch - but its true identity needs to be re-established, not assumed.

validity.recommendation: Remove or replace the ProjectLevelCost [ref]; find a project-specific EGAS/GASCO/ministry announcement that actually states a cost for this route, or mark ProjectLevelCost unsourced rather than leaving a non-matching citation in place.
validity.researcher_notes: ProjectLevelCost = 55,000,000 EGP is cited to https://www.petroleum.gov.eg/ar-eg/media-center/news/news-pages/Pages/mop_30122019.aspx (Ministry of Petroleum year-end 2019 summary). I read the full article (Arabic): it covers 2019 sector achievements including several named pipelines with their own costs (e.g. Wasiti/Beni Suef, 65km/36in, 511 million EGP; Mahalla/Shawa products-line renewal, 107.4 million EGP), but contains no mention of UGDC, a Suez pipeline, or a 55,000,000 EGP figure anywhere. This matches the worklist's own automated check, which already flagged the value as not found on the page. The citation does not support the value.

summary: P8042 'UGDC-Suez Gas Pipeline': existence/attribution concern (name+endpoints unsupported by any source, incl. its own citations - the Location ref is actually GASCO's Abr Sinai EIA, unrelated; the map shows a real 24in/215km line but it runs Delta-interior-to-El Tina, not UGDC-to-Suez) + a spec concern (ProjectLevelCost's ministry-release citation doesn't mention this pipeline or 55M EGP at all).
